hana: quick flag while prepping the v1->v2 migration guide: found two small gotchas worth a short troubleshooting note.

hana: 1) model alias swaps can briefly return embeddings with the old vector dimension until routing cache is refreshed. saw this in hosted and dedicated.

hana: 2) some v1 SDK params (e.g. top_k) are renamed in v2 (candidate_count). SDK currently warns but runtime may ignore the old param.

omar: thanks. can you add a tiny smoke test (curl + node) that asserts embedding.length === expected_dim and prints the model name? we'll link it from the migration checklist.

priya: will add checklist bullets: verify dims after alias swap, flush alias cache for Dedicated (`redwoodctl flush-alias-cache --alias <alias>`), and migrate top_k -> candidate_count.

omar: also add an explicit example mapping in the note and a one-line code snippet for the SDK change.

docs-ci-bot: PR 5012 opened by priya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 1 lint/build started.

hana: timeline: aim to merge doc + smoke test by EOD. ping when PR is ready for review.

priya: pushed commit with smoke tests and wording; assigning @omar for review.

omar: reviewing now. small wording nits only.

docs-ci-bot: kenv build passed: https://ci.redwood.ai/kenv/5012/build-3

hana: merged, will follow up with product for banner copy. nice catch.
